_doc: Maps common metric names to the Prometheus series exported by each runtime.
Use the first candidate present in the scrape. Return no value when none is present.
Sum label values within the selected family, but do not combine alternative families.
Add a mapping only after checking it against that runtime's metrics output.

concepts.generation_tokens: Monotonic count of generated tokens, excluding prompt tokens.
concepts.requests_running: Requests currently executing in the engine.
concepts.requests_waiting: Requests admitted but waiting to execute.
concepts.kv_cache_usage: Fraction (0-1) or percentage of the GPU KV cache in use.
concepts.prefix_cache_queries: Cumulative prefix-cache lookups; hits divided by queries gives the hit rate.
concepts.external_cache_hits: Hits served by an external or offload cache tier.
concepts.external_cache_queries: Lookups against an external or offload cache tier.

_note: The frontend does not expose KV-cache utilization. Leave it unknown unless another endpoint supplies it.
The output-token entries are alternatives; use one family at a time.
No metric mappings are currently defined for this runtime.
